author: product-requirements-expert
title: Owner listing treats a page below the first as the first page
summary: A page asked for below the first one (zero or negative) counts as a request for the first page: the owner listing responds normally with HTTP 200 instead of the error page.
acceptance_criteria: given more matching owners than fit on one page, when a page within range is asked for, then that page of matches is listed (HTTP 200)
given a page asked for as zero, when the listing runs, then the response is HTTP 200 carrying the first page of matches and not the error page
given a page asked for as a negative number, when the listing runs, then the response is HTTP 200 carrying the first page of matches and not the error page
the below-first-page rule holds both for an empty search listing every owner and for a last-name search
non_goals: behavior for a page past the last page of matches — recorded as an open question in docs/prd.md
the same input handling for the veterinarian directory listing
notes: Bug report: /owners?page=0 and any page value below 1 render the error page. New requirement REQ-OWN-005 in docs/prd.md, Owner records section; edge case 4 added there. New ubiquitous-language term: Owner listing. REQ-SYS-002 (error page on failure) is unaffected — an out-of-range low page is defined as not a failure.

author: system-design-expert
architectural_fit: Confirmed cause: OwnerController.findPaginatedForOwnersLastName builds PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize) (OwnerController.java:133-137), so page=0 yields index -1 and PageRequest.of throws IllegalArgumentException, which surfaces as the error page (REQ-SYS-002 path). Basis: direct read of the source file; no IDE oracle is connected in this run, so no symbol-resolution citation is available. The slice needs no new pattern. The page number is a web-layer concern only - the owner aggregate and OwnerRepository know nothing of page numbers, and Pageable is constructed inside the controller today. Clamping the requested page to the first page is request adaptation at the HTTP input boundary, exactly the Web controller row of the pattern catalog in docs/architecture-principles.md (bind the request, delegate, select the response) and the External input arrives row of docs/security-principles.md (validate type, range and shape before use). It is not a business rule, so the standing controllers-carry-rules deviation recorded in docs/system-design.md#package-structure is not widened. Adjustment: normalize page once at the top of processFindForm, before the value is used, rather than inside the pagination helper. docs/system-design.md Contracts row for OwnerController updated to name the boundary normalization and to add REQ-OWN-005 to Implements.
integration_points: processFindForm passes page to two collaborators: findPaginatedForOwnersLastName (query offset) and addPaginationModel (currentPage model attribute). Normalizing once at method entry keeps both consistent; clamping only inside the pagination helper would leave currentPage at 0 in the model and break the first/previous/next links in owners/ownersList.html, which branch on currentPage > 1 and currentPage < totalPages.
No repository, entity, template, or message-bundle change is required. The single-match redirect path and the no-match rejectValue path in processFindForm are unaffected.

patterns.description: existing one-based page parameter converted to a zero-based PageRequest inside the controller; keep that conversion where it is and feed it an already-normalized value

existing @WebMvcTest harness for this controller; add the new cases to this file. Its @MockitoBean OwnerRepository stub is the tolerated existing usage described in docs/testing-principles.md - extending the file is not a fresh mocking decision

risks.risk: Scope creep into the page-past-the-last-page case, which docs/prd.md keeps as an open question and the prd-entry lists as a non-goal
risks.mitigation: clamp only the low end; leave a high page number behaving exactly as it does today

risks.risk: VetController.findPaginated carries the identical PageRequest.of(page - 1, ...) construction and the same crash, but the vet directory is an explicit non-goal for this slice
risks.mitigation: leave vet untouched; a reviewer seeing the asymmetry should read it as deliberate slice scope, not an oversight. Extracting a shared pagination helper would couple the owner and vet feature packages, which the observed acyclic package graph does not allow, so a future vet fix repeats the normalization locally rather than sharing code

risks.risk: A non-numeric page value (?page=abc) fails type binding on a different path and is unchanged by this slice
risks.mitigation: out of scope; the acceptance criteria name zero and negative values only

notes: No ADR warranted: the decision is local, cheap to reverse, and carries no competing alternative worth recording - it fails the hard-to-reverse and real-trade-off bar in the adr-template skill. Durable-memory write is one row edit in docs/system-design.md (OwnerController Purpose plus Implements). No design-doc-autofix records exist in the log, so the autofix audit is a no-op. Ubiquitous language already carries Owner listing and first page (docs/ubiquitous-language.md:44); use those terms in test names and comments rather than search results grid or owner index.

author: feature-implementer
summary: Owner listing now treats a page below the first as the first page. processFindForm binds the query parameter as requestedPage and normalizes it once at method entry with Math.max(requestedPage, FIRST_PAGE), so both collaborators - findPaginatedForOwnersLastName (query offset) and addPaginationModel (currentPage model attribute) - see the same normalized value and the ownersList pagination links stay correct. Three new tests in OwnerControllerTests (processFindFormWithZeroPageReturnsFirstPage, processFindFormWithNegativePageReturnsFirstPage, processFindFormWithZeroPageAndEmptySearchReturnsFirstPage) cover zero and negative pages across both the last-name-search and empty-search paths; each asserts HTTP 200, the ownersList view, currentPage 1, and a captured Pageable at page index 0. All three failed with IllegalArgumentException before the fix. VetController left untouched per the slice non-goal; page-past-the-last-page left unchanged per the PRD open question. Gate: ./gradlew build, ./gradlew test (18 OwnerControllerTests green, full suite green), format check, handoff.py validate (5 records), handoff.py audit-autofix (clean). Note for reviewers: CLAUDE.md documents the format tasks as formatJava/checkJavaFormat, but this project's Gradle build exposes formatMain/formatAot and checkFormat (spring-javaformat); the documented task names do not exist. IDE static-analysis pre-check not run - no IntelliJ MCP oracle connected in this run.

author: security-reviewer
approved_aspects: Untrusted `page` query parameter is bound as a primitive `int`, so Spring's type conversion rejects non-numeric input at the binder before any application code sees it; the change does not widen the accepted type or introduce manual parsing.

Normalization `int page = Math.max(requestedPage, FIRST_PAGE)` runs once at method entry, before any use, so both `findPaginatedForOwnersLastName` and `addPaginationModel` receive the same trusted value - no TOCTOU-style split between a validated copy and a raw copy.

Arithmetic is safe at both extremes: the normalized `page` is always >= 1, so `PageRequest.of(page - 1, pageSize)` cannot underflow to a negative index, and `Integer.MAX_VALUE` yields a valid high offset that returns an empty page handled by the existing not-found branch. No integer-overflow path introduced.

No injection surface added: `page` reaches the database only as a Spring Data `PageRequest` offset on a derived query (`findByLastNameStartingWith`), never as concatenated SQL or JPQL, matching the SQL-injection mitigation recorded in docs/system-design.md#threat-model.

No XSS surface added: the only new model exposure is `currentPage`, an `int` rendered through Thymeleaf's default-escaping expression output. No user-controlled string is newly echoed, and no `th:utext` or unescaped sink is introduced.

The change narrows rather than widens exposure: a page below the first previously raised IllegalArgumentException into the error page, which docs/prd.md REQ-SYS-002 records as leaking technical failure detail. Serving HTTP 200 with the normal listing removes that attacker-reachable stack-trace path.
No authentication, authorization, session, or CSRF surface is touched; the route remains the same unauthenticated GET it already was, and the change adds no state mutation.
No secrets introduced: a full-diff sweep for password/secret/token/api-key/credential patterns returns nothing, and no configuration, properties, or manifest file is in the change set.

Supply chain unchanged: `scripts/changeset.sh --name-only` shows no build.gradle, lockfile, or dependency-manifest edit. The one new test import (`org.mockito.ArgumentCaptor`) resolves to the already-declared test dependency, adding no new coordinate or version to verify against the NVD.

Documentation changes (prd.md, system-design.md, ubiquitous-language.md) are prose only and introduce no security-relevant claim that the code contradicts; the system-design contract row now records the boundary normalization where a reviewer will find it.

author: test-reviewer

findings.description: The three new tests (processFindFormWithZeroPageReturnsFirstPage, processFindFormWithNegativePageReturnsFirstPage, processFindFormWithZeroPageAndEmptySearchReturnsFirstPage) differ only in the page query value and whether a lastName search parameter is present — a textbook repetitive case testing-principles.md flags for @ParameterizedTest. Consolidating into one @ParameterizedTest with @CsvSource over {page value} x {search type} also closes a coverage gap: no test currently exercises a negative page (-3) together with the empty search path — only zero+empty and negative+lastName are covered, not negative+empty. PRD edge case 4 (docs/prd.md) requires the below-first-page rule to hold identically 'whether the listing came from an empty search or from a last-name search', which implies both page values need to be tried against both search paths.

author: change-grader
summary: normalize a below-first owner-listing page to the first page

blast_radius.note: Ten production lines in one method of one class, plus tests in the sibling package and three prose-only doc files; no sensitive paths, no config, no dependency or schema change, and the only runtime reach is the existing GET /owners handler.

semantic_surprise.note: Reading the hunks, Math.max(requestedPage, FIRST_PAGE) is applied once at method entry and flows to both consumers, so PageRequest.of(page - 1, 5) can no longer underflow and currentPage stays consistent with the query offset; the parameter rename keeps an explicit name = "page" binding, so no query-string contract shifts, and behavior for page >= 1 is byte-for-byte unchanged.

test_adequacy.note: The parameterized test asserts real outcomes rather than restating the implementation - HTTP 200, the ownersList view, currentPage of 1, and a captured Pageable page index of 0 - across all four combinations of page value (0, -3) and search path (last-name, empty), and every row would fail against the pre-fix IllegalArgumentException or against a mis-signed normalization.

reviewer_hedging.note: The final fix-delta roster was test-reviewer alone and it approved with an empty findings list; the two earlier autofix findings were test-structure and naming issues that were fixed and re-reviewed clean, and the three non-roster reviewers had already approved with no findings, so nothing lingers on this change.

scope_deviation.note: Zero build retries, zero consultations, zero design revisions, and the diff covers exactly the surface the PRD entry and design block named; the identical page-below-one exposure in the veterinarian listing was deliberately left alone and recorded as an Open Question rather than quietly swept in.

rationale: A contained boundary normalization in one request handler, verified by reading the hunks: no underflow path remains, valid pages are unaffected, and the tests fail against the old code. Confirm and merge; note only that the same defect still stands in the veterinarian listing.
